title: Export selected authorized supplier purchase exposure page to Excel
description: A purchasing user downloads exactly the selected dynamic supplier exposure current page as xlsx in chosen field order, using existing ExcelExporter. Development only. Reuse ERP-031 SupplierPurchaseExposure.ForQueryAsync, its supplier/currency/date/link-status filters and bounded page; recheck the current user's purchase-order menu for every request, fail closed on missing permission and invalid filters, and use existing HTTP operation audit. Keep linked settlement evidence separate from ambiguous/unavailable references, preserve null unknown amounts and original currencies, and state this is not accounts payable or payment authority. No arbitrary SQL, migration, production SQL, real database execution, writes, secrets/.env change or deployment. Verify focused tests and safe Release build/test; no real-browser acceptance.
acceptance_criteria: Excel endpoint reuses ERP-148 authorized bounded preview and rechecks current-user menu, filters, selected fields and page limit before bytes.
Workbook contains only current-page chosen columns in requested order; null unknown amounts remain unknown, currencies remain separate and formula-leading text is literal.
Designer offers xlsx with visible empty/authorization errors; workbook tests cover order, cap, linked ambiguity, unknowns, currency, formula safety and no writes; document limits.
